content.json:
# ATLAS Behavior Map
Alerts from the ABM analytic rules by behavior and MITRE ATLAS tactic, and the ATLAS coverage of the installed rule set. ATLAS IDs come from each alert's custom details (BehaviorId, AtlasTechnique, AtlasTactics).

content.query:
let AbmAlerts = SecurityAlert
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend CustomDetails = todynamic(tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]))
| extend B = CustomDetails.BehaviorId, T = CustomDetails.AtlasTactics, P = CustomDetails.AtlasTechnique
| extend BehaviorId = tostring(iff(gettype(B) == "array", B[0], B)),
         AtlasTactics = tostring(iff(gettype(T) == "array", T[0], T)),
         AtlasTechnique = tostring(iff(gettype(P) == "array", P[0], P))
| where isnotempty(BehaviorId);
AbmAlerts
| summarize Alerts = count() by BehaviorId
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by BehaviorId

content.query:
let AbmAlerts = SecurityAlert
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend CustomDetails = todynamic(tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]))
| extend B = CustomDetails.BehaviorId, T = CustomDetails.AtlasTactics, P = CustomDetails.AtlasTechnique
| extend BehaviorId = tostring(iff(gettype(B) == "array", B[0], B)),
         AtlasTactics = tostring(iff(gettype(T) == "array", T[0], T)),
         AtlasTechnique = tostring(iff(gettype(P) == "array", P[0], P))
| where isnotempty(BehaviorId);
let Tactics = datatable(Tactic:string, TacticName:string) ["AML.TA0002", "Reconnaissance", "AML.TA0003", "Resource Development", "AML.TA0004", "Initial Access", "AML.TA0000", "AI Model Access", "AML.TA0005", "Execution", "AML.TA0006", "Persistence", "AML.TA0012", "Privilege Escalation", "AML.TA0007", "Defense Evasion", "AML.TA0013", "Credential Access", "AML.TA0008", "Discovery", "AML.TA0015", "Lateral Movement", "AML.TA0009", "Collection", "AML.TA0001", "AI Attack Staging", "AML.TA0014", "Command and Control", "AML.TA0010", "Exfiltration", "AML.TA0011", "Impact"];
AbmAlerts
| mv-expand Tactic = split(AtlasTactics, ",") to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter Tactics on Tactic
| summarize Alerts = count() by AtlasTactic = strcat(Tactic, " ", TacticName)
| sort by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by ATLAS tactic

content.query:
let AbmAlerts = SecurityAlert
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend CustomDetails = todynamic(tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]))
| extend B = CustomDetails.BehaviorId, T = CustomDetails.AtlasTactics, P = CustomDetails.AtlasTechnique
| extend BehaviorId = tostring(iff(gettype(B) == "array", B[0], B)),
         AtlasTactics = tostring(iff(gettype(T) == "array", T[0], T)),
         AtlasTechnique = tostring(iff(gettype(P) == "array", P[0], P))
| where isnotempty(BehaviorId);
AbmAlerts
| mv-expand Tactic = split(AtlasTactics, ",") to typeof(string)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Tactic, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: ABM alerts over time by ATLAS tactic

content.query:
let AbmAlerts = SecurityAlert
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| extend CustomDetails = todynamic(tostring(todynamic(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]))
| extend B = CustomDetails.BehaviorId, T = CustomDetails.AtlasTactics, P = CustomDetails.AtlasTechnique
| extend BehaviorId = tostring(iff(gettype(B) == "array", B[0], B)),
         AtlasTactics = tostring(iff(gettype(T) == "array", T[0], T)),
         AtlasTechnique = tostring(iff(gettype(P) == "array", P[0], P))
| where isnotempty(BehaviorId);
AbmAlerts
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, BehaviorId, AtlasTechnique, AtlasTactics, SystemAlertId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Recent ABM alerts
